Singleton gives q separate frozen-terminal components. Published arXiv:2408.04802 Thm 5.1 plus the min-max interval/directed-cycle equivalence assigns each component its homotopy type. Standalone checker verified 19 examples across 6950 homomorphisms and 51624 enumerated cells; checks corroborate, do not establish universal proof.

value.rationale: The generalized theta family naturally extends cycles to source graphs of cycle rank at least two; its Hom complex can be empty, entirely contractible, a union of circles, or a mixture. Closed winding-vector counts give all homotopy component numbers uniformly without a coloring-state enumeration, including the structural frozen-flexible transition and q-fold multiplicity at one feasible displacement. Exact natural infinite-family invariant, not an ad-hoc finite slice.
